## Summary

- Bullet-point summary of what changed and why.
- Focus on the intent and behavior, not just file diffs.

## Test Plan

Describe how you verified the change. Use checkboxes where helpful.

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Manual testing

Details (commands, scenarios, etc.):

```bash
# example commands, if applicable
dotnet test
```

If no tests were added, explain why.

## Issue Link (if applicable)

Link the corresponding issue, when one exists:

- `Closes #<issue-number>`

Not every PR needs an issue (minor fixes may not warrant a tracked issue).

## Breaking Changes (if applicable)

- Describe any breaking changes and their impact.
- Include migration notes or follow-up steps if needed.

If there are no breaking changes, you can write “None.”

## Known Limitations / Notes (optional)

- Any known limitations, deferred scope, or behavior intentionally preserved.
- Any follow-up work that should be tracked separately (link issues if created).
